prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Overhead still life of four blank card folders fanned in graded blues on a mist-grey surface, one folder open to show blank ruled sheets inside. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: the open folder rimmed with a thin edge of amber enamel. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
